requirement: Soft delete a risk factor by id: stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt on the link only, leaving its pathogen, criterion, and sibling risk factors live, and report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live risk factor exists for the target id
Sibling risk factors and the referenced pathogen and criterion exist
The target id matches no live risk factor, or it is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Delete the only risk factor in the table
Delete a risk factor while a control row and its parents stay live
Delete one of two risk factors sharing the same pathogen
Second delete request for an already deleted row
Delete the middle one of three risk factors
Delete request with an unknown id

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the row is soft-deleted and hidden by the query filter
The pathogen, criterion, and sibling risk factors stay untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Risk factor not found' error
A rejected delete never moves an existing deletion timestamp

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or already-deleted row is returned as a failed Result
